newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser-Busch, Grupo Modelo deal hits snag.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser-Busch, Grupo Modelo deal hits snag.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc and Grupo Modelo SA de CV said Monday they were unable to finalize Anheuser-Busch's purchase of a larger share of the Mexican brewer because of differences of opinion on certain price valuations.

The investment agreement between the companies spells out measures for resolving such disputes, the companies said, adding they will follow those procedures, which include continued discussions and, if necessary, binding arbitration.
"We're optimistic that the transaction can be completed in the near future," said Anheuser-Busch chairman and President August Busch III.

In 1993, Anheuser-Busch purchased a 17.7 percent direct and indirect interest in Grupo Modelo and its Diblo subsidiary and secured options to purchase a larger equity position up to 50.2 percent, the companies said. Those options could be exercised between mid-1995 and the end of 1997.
In December, Anheuser-Busch's board approved the purchase of an additional 25 percent of Grupo Modelo.
